;Business and economy
*[[Lebanon]] says it will [[Default (finance)|default]] on a [[eurobond (external bond)|eurobond]] repayment and pursue restructuring its debt. The country has never before defaulted. Lebanon's [[government of Lebanon|government]] debt is about 170% of its yearly [[gross domestic product]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/07/lebanon-to-default-on-debt-for-first-time-amid-financial-crisis (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Collapse of Xinjia Express Hotel]]
**A hotel being used for [[quarantining]] those with COVID-19 [[building collapse|collapses]] in [[Quanzhou]], [[Fujian]], [[China]]. Ten people were killed and twenty-three are trapped. Thirty-eight have been rescued alive. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/03/07/china/china-coronavirus-hotel-collapse/index.html (CNN)]
*Twenty-two people are killed and more than 70 are injured when a [[tank truck]], two buses and another vehicle [[multiple-vehicle collision|collide]] in the road between [[Damascus]] and [[Homs]], in [[Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-crash/road-crash-in-syria-kills-22-injures-70-state-media-idUSKBN20U0V7?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[Malta]] reports its first case of COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-malta/italian-girl-becomes-maltas-first-coronavirus-case-idUSKBN20U0GK?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[Bulgaria]] reports its first two cases. [https://dariknews.bg/novini/bylgariia/koronavirus-v-bylgariia-dvama-s-polozhitelni-probi-bez-da-sa-pytuvali-v-chuzhbina-2215559 (Darik News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Nicola Zingaretti]], the [[President of Lazio]] since 2013 and [[List of Secretaries of the Democratic Party (Italy)|Secretary]] of the [[Democratic Party (Italy)|Democratic Party]] since 2019, confirmed he has contracted the virus. [https://www.repubblica.it/politica/2020/03/07/news/coronavirus_zingaretti_positivo_al_test-250519476/ (''La Repubblica'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***The [[Maldives]] report its first two confirmed cases of COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-maldives/maldives-confirms-first-two-cases-of-coronavirus-idUSKBN20U0QP (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****Newly elected member of [[Islamic Consultative Assembly|parliament]] [[Fatemeh Rahbar]] dies after contracting [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2020/03/572595/another-iranian-mp-dies-covid-19 (''Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****A 50-year-old man is arrested for breaching quarantine and traveling to two crowded bars in [[Gamagōri]] after testing positive for COVID-19 the day prior. He reportedly told family members he intended to spread it and bragged to bar employees that he had tested positive. [https://www.tokyoreporter.com/japan/aichi-man-infected-with-coronavirus-goes-to-bars-to-spread-it/ (Tokyo Reporter)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****The Ministry of Health of Argentina confirmed the country's first death due to COVID-19, a 64-year-old man who had traveled to Paris who also had other health conditions. This marks the first death due to COVID-19 in [[Latin America]]. [https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2020/03/07/confirman-la-primera-muerte-por-coronavirus-en-argentina/ (''Infobae'' in Spanish)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Paraguay]]
****[[Paraguay]] reports its first case of COVID-19. [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2020/03/07/paraguay-confirma-primer-caso-de-coronavirus/ (''Infobae'' in Spanish)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Afghan presidential election]]
**A spokesman for politician [[Abdullah Abdullah]] announces he will hold a parallel presidential inauguration ceremony next week after he declares himself the winner of the election. Incumbent [[President of Afghanistan|President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] was declared the winner. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-politics/afghan-political-rivals-issue-parallel-invites-for-inauguration-ceremonies-idUSKBN20U0WA?il=0 (Reuters)]
